text: Good evening, I am writing regarding my son who is 3 months old. Since yesterday evening he is having one eye which is sticky and pinkish, the left one, in the morning the eyelashes were stuck together with some yellowish discharge. I have been cleaning it with cotton wool and boiled cooled water as my mother-in-law suggested, it comes again after some time. Tonight I checked his temperature with the digital thermometer under his arm and it is showing 39.7. I checked two times only to be sure, both times same reading. My husband is on night shift so I am alone with baby and thought better to ask properly instead of guessing. I have not given any medicine as I was not sure what is allowed at this age. Kindly advise what should be done, whether this can wait till morning for the GP or we should take him somewhere tonight. Thank you.
